subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Rural life and urban life have many common sides. (a) ⎯⎯ differences between them are greater. Country people do not have enough educational and medical facilities. (b) ⎯⎯ they face problems with their communication network. (c) ⎯⎯, the city people enjoy all sorts of modern facilities. (d) ⎯⎯ they enjoy a nice communication system. (e) ⎯⎯ there is a rush of people to come to cities from village every year.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) that (b) At first (c) But (d) Though (e) If

subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Dengue fever is a serious disease (a) ⎯⎯ is caused by a kind of virus called 'Dengue' virus. (b) ⎯⎯ this virus was identified in Africa. (c) ⎯⎯ now it has spread all over the world. (d) ⎯⎯ in most cases dengue fever has its remedy, it is better to prevent it. (e) ⎯⎯. we keep our surroundings clean and be conscious of it, we can easily avoid this disease.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) that (b) At first (c) But (d) Though (e) If
